condo: ⭐️ Move-In Ready Penthouse /w Lake Views | Huge Size | Beside MRT & Top International School⭐

history.summary: A 2278 sqft 4BR penthouse (identified as Lakefront Residences, 99-yr leasehold, next to Lakeside MRT) for $3M / $1317 PSF in the Jurong Lake District catchment. The low PSF is an oversized-penthouse artefact and the $3M absolute price sits well above the liquid band; with all URA appreciation/liquidity data null, the JLD catalyst alone cannot offset the exit-risk and missing-data concerns.
history.rating_rationale: Web research identifies this as a Lakefront Residences penthouse — 99-yr leasehold, beside EW26 Lakeside MRT, in the Jurong Lake District ('2nd CBD') growth zone, which is a genuine long-term catalyst. But every URA field (appreciation, txn count, median PSF, bias) is null, so there is no quantitative support; 2278 sqft for $3M is an oversized penthouse where the $1317 PSF looks cheap only because of size, and $3M penthouses have a thin buyer pool. JLD upside vs missing-data + exit risk nets to Neutral.
